ui.text.cis_content_is_never_bundled_or_dow: CIS content is never bundled or downloaded. Import your own licensed CIS Intune build-kit ZIP or a schema-1 JSON rule pack below; PDF and Excel benchmarks are not supported. Choose platforms first; unavailable pack combinations cannot run until a suitable pack is imported. The Microsoft catalog contains five bundled checks total, all partial inventories: Windows 26H2 has two shell SmartScreen atomic checks, legacy Endpoint Protection only (Graph beta), not modern baseline/Settings Catalog coverage. macOS has one FileVault enablement check, legacy Endpoint Protection on Graph beta; the template is deprecated, not current-template, recovery-key or encryption compliance coverage. iOS/iPadOS has one personal level 1 passcode check, legacy device restrictions only, not organization-owned coverage. Android has one personally-owned work profile level 2 encryption compliance requirement check, not organization-owned profiles or discovered device encryption. Unknown OS/enrollment applicability is not assessed; no full-baseline or device-compliance claim.
ui.text.configuration_alignment_only_not_de: Configuration alignment only, not device compliance or certification. Missing means absent/not configured only in the mapped families and policy types read completely for that rule, not tenant-wide absence. Potential conflict means differing configured values, not proven targeting overlap or an Intune conflict. Unassigned policies do not establish device coverage; groups, exclusions and filters are not resolved. Partial inventories cover listed checks only, not a full baseline or benchmark. User-selected context is not discovered device inventory. Unknown applicability remains not assessed.

server.doc.export_explanation: The exporter signs in interactively as an administrator using a Microsoft first-party public client and requests read-only delegated Graph permissions. No application registration is created, no client secret exists, and the export is limited to whatever the signing-in administrator is permitted to read.
server.doc.drift_explanation: Re-running the export overwrites only what changed, so the commit history of this repository is an audit trail of Intune configuration drift.

server.text.this_is_configuration_alignment_not: This is configuration alignment, not effective device compliance or certification. Assignments are evidence only; group membership, filters and effective targeting are not resolved. Potential conflict does not establish targeting overlap or an Intune conflict.
server.text.pack_origin_distinguishes_applicati: Pack origin distinguishes application-reviewed bundled resources from customer-imported packs. Imported framework/classification labels are author-declared, not verified Microsoft authority. Windows-family policy metadata is not discovered Windows 11 inventory; a supplied target build establishes comparison context only.
server.text.missing_means_absent_not_configured: Missing means absent/not configured only in the mapped families and policy types read completely for this rule, not tenant-wide absence. Partial packs cover only their listed checks, not the entire benchmark. User-selected context is not discovered device inventory. Legacy-only mappings do not cover equivalent modern policy families. Personal-only iOS/iPadOS and Android profiles do not establish organization-owned coverage. A macOS beta/deprecated template reference does not establish current-template or device encryption compliance.
server.text.assessment_coverage_assessed_listed: Assessment coverage = assessed / listed controls excluding notApplicable; unknown applicability stays in the denominator. Configuration alignment = aligned / assessed (aligned, misaligned, missing, potentialConflict). Null percentages are not available, never 100%.
